{"path": "slab_relax.in", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for aluminum slab relaxation
# Surface normal direction: [0, 0, 1]

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p s

# Read structure and replicate
read_data /results/10_feb_melting/claude_45/tool_calling/surface_energy/subtask/level_1/brief/aluminum_surface_1_subtask_structure_retrieval_trial_1/structure.data
replicate 5 5 5

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization settings
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step pe ke etotal temp press vol

# Perform conjugate gradient minimization
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Write relaxed structure
write_data relaxed_slab.data

# Print final energy
variable final_energy equal pe
print "Final potential energy: ${final_energy} eV"
"}
